environment.description: Deployed on EKS 1.29 with Bottlerocket AMI nodes. Pod manifest specifies securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem: true at the container level. The only writable mount is a memory-backed emptyDir (medium: Memory, sizeLimit: 10Mi) at /tmp for ASP.NET temporary data directory override via ASPNETCORE_TEMP environment variable. The /app/uploads path has NO volume mount — it resolves to the container's overlay rootfs which is mounted read-only by the CRI runtime. Container runs as non-root UID 1654 with allowPrivilegeEscalation: false. Node-level SELinux in enforcing mode with container_file_t labels preventing writes outside designated mount points.

config.notes: No volume mounted at /app/uploads - path resolves to read-only overlay rootfs
